rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets, ceiling, and walls is unambiguous property damage to the home structure and contents.
claim_summary: Kitchen fire caused by grease flare-up on stove, extinguished by claimant with fire extinguisher. Charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls; rest of house unaffected, no injuries. Homeowners policy POL-1001 covers property damage with $500 deductible and $250,000 limit.

case_facts.description: Grease fire on stove, extinguished with fire extinguisher; charred cabinets above stove, smoke damage to ceiling and walls

rationale: Flooding caused by policyholder's own burst plumbing supply line resulting in damage to home structure and contents (hardwood floor, drywall, stored items) is textbook property_damage coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel returned from a work trip to find basement flooded with approximately two inches of water throughout, caused by a burst plumbing supply line. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to one foot high, and ruined stored boxes. Estimated damage likely exceeds $25,000; prompt on-site inspection recommended.

case_facts.description: flooding with two inches of water throughout basement; hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to one foot high, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.cause: burst plumbing supply line (policyholder's own home)

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) is clearly property damage to the home's own structure.
claim_summary: Homeowner Jordan Lee (POL-1006) reports wind damage to back porch overhang, with four shingles blown off during last weekend's wind event. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no water intrusion or other damage. However, the $2,500 deductible exceeds the estimated damage amount.

case_facts.description: wind damage - four shingles blown off
